answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making each new identity earn a growing reef of attestations from independent established peers: the first identity needs 3, the second 6, the third 12, doubling each time. Attestations only count if the attestor kernel of verified history is independent, so a farm own relic accounts cannot attest each other. The tenth fake identity therefore costs 1536 attestations it cannot manufacture, and the price grows with every extra identity instead of staying flat.
